events.context: Reported blowout Mounjaro revenue and raised full-year 2024 revenue guidance by $3.0B, alleviating supply shortage fears.
Wholesaler channel inventory destocking caused unexpected Mounjaro/Zepbound revenue miss and full-year profit guidance trim.
Blockbuster Q4 results with 43% revenue growth and initial FY2026 revenue guidance crossing $80B, igniting institutional inflows.
Strong 56% revenue growth and FY2026 revenue guidance hike to $82.0-$85.0B met high market expectations.
Surpassed revenue consensus by >$2.2B ($23.0B vs $20.8B) and lifted full-year revenue outlook to $85.0-$87.0B, overcoming $3.03/share IPR&D noise.

conditionalFraming: Eli Lilly shares historically surge (+5% to +14%) when quarterly incretin prescription and manufacturing volume beats expectations and triggers upward full-year revenue revisions. Conversely, the equity is highly sensitive to distribution channel friction, experiencing severe drawdowns (-8% to -10%) when wholesaler inventory destocking or manufacturing yield hiccups create transitory top-line misses.
